## 📌 Description
Implement screenshot‑based visual comparison using Playwright’s built‑in `expect(page).toHaveScreenshot()` and manage baseline images.

## ✅ Tasks
- [ ] **Baseline Image Management**
- Store baseline screenshots in `src/test/resources/visual-baselines/`
- Naming convention: `{testClass}_{testName}_{viewport}.png`

- [ ] **Visual Comparison Utility**
- `VisualValidator.java` – wrapper around Playwright’s screenshot assertion
- Configurable threshold (pixel mismatch percentage)
- Automatic baseline generation on first run with `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=true`

- [ ] **Test Implementation**
- `TC_005` – Navigate to TodoMVC, take full‑page screenshot, compare baseline
- `TC_006` – Test responsive layout with two viewport sizes

- [ ] **CI Integration**
- On failure, upload diff images as artifacts
- Allow maintainers to review and promote new baselines via PR

## 🔍 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] First run creates baseline images (or updates with env var)
- [ ] Subsequent runs fail if visual changes exceed threshold
- [ ] Diff images clearly highlight changed regions

## 📎 Dependencies
- [ ] v0.5.0 (Advanced Playwright) complete

## 🧪 Testing
- [ ] Deliberately change a CSS class → test fails with diff image
- [ ] Run `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=true mvn test` to update all baselines
- [ ] Visual tests execute in headless CI without X11 dependencies
